You will drive the flight control system throughout its complete development lifecycle, from system-level requirements definition through architecture development, preliminary and detailed design, supplier coordination, integration, verification and validation activities, and ultimately system and aircraft certification.

Working cross-functionally with structures, avionics, flight physics, systems, and overall aircraft design, you will ensure robust integration of the flight control system within the aircraft. As a senior engineer, you will play a central role in technical decision-making, system trade-offs, and the maturation of the overall aircraft configuration.

Actively contribute to the design implementation and configuration control of the flight control system within the aircraft Digital Mock-Up (DMU), ensuring proper integration with structures and other aircraft systems.
Support the flight controls certification process, including preparation and review of certification plans, compliance checklists, qualification documentation and execution, and participation in ground and flight test campaigns.

Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering or Mechanical Engineering(or equivalent).
Minimum 8 years of hands-on experience in the development of mechanically actuated aircraft flight control systems, preferably within Part 23aircraftprogramsoperatingunder a DOA environment or international equivalent.
Strong background in systems engineering applied to flight controls, including requirement capture and management, functional decomposition, interface definition, and traceability.
Demonstrated expertise in the design, integration, assembly, and testing of mechanical primary flight control systems, including kinematics, load transmission, tolerance management, friction and free-play control, and troubleshooting during ground and flight test campaigns.
Proven experience across the full product development lifecycle, from conceptual architecture and preliminary design through detailed design, verification, validation, and certification (Part 23 or Part 25).
Solid understanding of airworthiness and certification processes, including compliance demonstration and interaction with airworthiness authorities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional European languages are an asset.
Proficiency in PLM and CAD systems; Dassault’s 3DX platform is a plus.
Self-driven, solution-oriented professional with strong ownership mindset and the ability to operate effectively in a dynamic development environment.

Avec plus de 13'000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices représentant 160 métiers, les Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève sont un établissement de référence au niveau national et international. Pour en savoir plus sur notre institution, prenez quelques minutes pour découvrir les moments forts de l-année 2025 en cliquant ici.
La Direction de la transformation numérique et de l'IA (DTN-IA) créée, intègre et gère toutes les applications informatiques d'un des systèmes d'information hospitalier les plus performants afin de soutenir les activités cliniques et logistiques des Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève.

Avec un parc de plus de 12'500 postes, 1'300 serveurs pour plus de 250 applications au service de l'ensemble du personnel, disponible 24h/24h et 7j/7j, la DTN-IA gère un système d'information RH pour les 13'000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs des HUG et des 7 autres institutions genevoises et un ERP performant pour les processus logistiques et financiers des plus complexes.

Par ailleurs, la DTN-IA intègre des équipements biomédicaux de pointe et du quotidien ainsi que des applications spécialisées pour tous les plateaux médico-techniques.
Le métier de la DTN-IA est de soutenir les activités quotidiennes et de bâtir le futur d'un hôpital moderne et performant, selon les axes stratégiques de l'Institution en s'appuyant sur les meilleures pratiques et les standards les plus exigeants.
Description du poste
Evoluant dans un environnement technique dynamique et moderne au service de la patientèle et des collaborateurs et collaboratrices des HUG, l-équipe Systèmes Serveurs est responsable de l-administration des infrastructures hébergeant les applications métiers critiques.

En tant que spécialiste Linux/containers/IA/automatisation au sein de cette équipe, vous contribuez à l-évolution du Système d-Informations en apportant des solutions techniques innovantes et en assurant la fiabilité, la sécurité et la performance des systèmes 24h/7j.
Vous concevez et administrez les serveurs virtuels et physiques Linux ainsi que les systèmes de conteneurisation et d-orchestration (idéalement Kubernetes Rancher, Docker Swarm).
Vous mettez en œuvre les outils et procédures nécessaires à une production optimale et de qualité (coûts, fiabilité, performances, surveillance, normes et standards).

1+ years of experience with networking technologies and the Linux operating system environment.
1+ year of scripting experience.

Expert working knowledge (including the ability to setup, configure, upgrade, manage, and troubleshoot) Windows-based systems and services such as DHCP, DNS, IIS, MS-SQL, NPS, etc.

Expertise in source code and version control tools.
Experience with configuration management, provisioning, infrastructure as code, and other DevOps concepts and tools.
Strong familiarity with Windows Server 2016/2019 (i.e. AD, DNS, DHCP, etc).
Networking experience in IPv4, switching, routing, firewalls and HA architecture.
Must be comfortable working with mission critical and sensitive systems, with a sense of urgency appropriate to the responsibilities.
Excellent communications skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, management etc. in both formal and informal situations.

Active Top Secret or TS/SCI with Polygraph. Note that an active clearance may provide the opportunity for you to work on sensitive SpaceX missions. If so, you will be subject to pre-employment drug and random drug and alcohol testing.
